Phase 1. Block C-01: scrape X posts via existing x-api or topic-radar.ts. Score sentiment. Tag by domain (AI/crypto/regulatory/market). Feed into Block D Oracle Synthesis.

Project root: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight
Target file to CREATE: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/scripts/scrape-posts.js
The script must: (1) use twitterApi.js fetchRecentSearch() to pull posts for each tracked domain (AI, crypto, regulation, web3), (2) score sentiment via Ollama qwen3:4b with a short prompt, (3) tag each post by domain, (4) upsert into Supabase posts table. Include deduplication by post_id. ES module syntax.
